items.text: [img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/46237554/98ec6c4847e608d3d1699c7b1c11df97b4649d26.png"]
Hey Builders,
The 8 Player Lobbies & Costumes Update v4.0 for Dumb Ways to Build released today on Steam, introducing a highly requested feature!

We’ve expanded the lobby size so you can now assemble a crew of up to 8 players, and put your friendships and construction skills to the test. Expect more chaos, sabotage and hilarious fails. Please do keep in mind that this feature is currently in Beta, so we are still continuing to optimize server performance, and you may encounter some other unexpected issues. Continue to report any bugs you encounter to our team and we will get onto the job!

To get into the spirit of Halloween, we have introduced full-body costumes for players! Transform your bean-sona into an Alien, Skeleton or perhaps a character you may recognise from the Dumb Ways to Die song.
This free update also includes a spooky takeover of the lobby, extra accessories and plenty of bug fixes and quality of live improvements. Check out the full Update Notes below! Happy building!
Update v4.0
Steam
Build ID: 26119457
Feature Updates
Gather a crew and get to work in 8 Player Lobbies
Lobbies have expanded to be able to play with up to 8 players.
Please note, that as this feature is in its beta phase, lobbies with a player count of 5 or more may experience some instability.
Brand new full-body Costumes and cosmetics
Costumes are a new cosmetic type that fully replaces your character's body.
You can still equip additional cosmetics on top of these Costumes, but certain types will have a more limited set of customization options.
To celebrate Halloween, every player will get a Skeleton Costume for free
To unlock additional Costumes, you will need to complete every certification for a Crisis Job to earn that level’s Costumes.
Complete the 5-Star Service certification in Hotel Hapless unlocks the Hapless Costume
Complete the Life’s a Beach certification in Beach Breach unlocks the Buff Bean Costume.
Complete the Sanitary Conditions certification in Drain Strain unlocks the Doomed Costume.
Complete the Cloud Nine certification in Crane Climb unlocks the Alien Costume.
Customize your character further with new cosmetics: Witches Hat and Fangs.
A spooky Halloween takeover in the Lobby awaits!
Get into the spirit of the season with bats, coffins and spiderwebs.
An unsettling seance and fishing pier added to the pre-built structures in the Lobby.
Quality of Life Improvements
Building materials can now be pinned to movable platforms, such as Cranes. Once the Crane begins to move, all pinned items will be unpinned.
Improvement in tools effect on Pirahnas, Sewer Slimes and Crabs. These creatures will now die in one hit when using a hammer or demolition charge.
Increased the randomness of objects you can get from floating object piles in Hotel Hapless and Crane Climb
Added extra building materials to various areas in Drain Strain.
Extended the wave collider in Beach Breach Master Builder to lower the chance of being stunned while hiding behind rocks.
Improved the colliders on the broken boat in Beach Breach for better traversal.
A new billboard has been added to the Lobby to celebrate one of our players.
Improved visual clarity of oil in Beach Breach.
Bug Fixes
Fixed an issue where levels would not load if the host of the lobby was shooting other players.
Fixed a bug where Bluetooth headset microphones were not detecting input correctly.
Fixed an issue where the “Shark Bait” certification was triggering when players were thrown on solid ground above shark infested waters.
Fixed an issue where a player affected by “Shonky’s Shrinky Drinky” would be off centre when picked up by another player
Fixed an issue where attempting to “Suck” using the Blow-Vac while it is full caused controllers to continuously vibrate.
Fixed an issue where player’s hands animations were snapping back into place incorrectly.
Fixed an issue where dead player’s bodies could float in mid-air after being retrieved with a Plunger Gun.
Fixed an issue where objects were not correctly being affected by the cars knockback in Hotel Hapless.
Fixed an issue where schools of fish would appear above the water in Beach Breach.
Fixed a desync issue when a player was thrown while under the effects of Alien Zero-G.
Fixed an issue where pulling out the Nail Gun after picking up another player would cause visual desyncs.
Fixed an issue where the player's mouths would continue to move after dying.
Fixed an issue where players would become invisible after dying.
Fixed an issue where the incorrect text was being displayed above some revive stations in Crane Climb.
Fixed a bug where the throwing bar UI would disappear if another item was highlighted while the first item was being thrown
Fixed a visual issue with the scrollbar in the customization menu.

releases.displayName: Dumb Ways to Build - 8 Player Lobbies & Costumes Update

items.text: Hey Builders,
We’re excited to announce that a brand new update for Dumb Ways to Build is coming on October 25 PDT!

The 8 Player Lobbies & Costumes Update, is dialing up the chaos and doubling the mayhem, as you will be able to gather your friends and form a crew of up to 8 players in a single lobby. Plus, to get into the spirit of the spooky season, we’re introducing full body cosmetics. So, if you don’t have a Halloween costume, we’ve got you covered!
Read on for a sneak peak of what you’ll find in Update 4.0!
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/46237554/6814dbbd777b995a8395c19dacb9e040537569fa.png"]

You asked, and we delivered! We’ve heard your requests for larger crews, and we can’t wait to bring you a beta version of 8 Player Lobbies in the upcoming update. If you thought managing a construction crew of 4 was chaotic, expanding to a crew of 8 will test your coordination skills and teamwork like never before.

While Dumb Ways to Build was originally developed and balanced around a 4-player co-op experience, we couldn’t pass up the chance to amp up the mayhem and push your crew to the limit. Please do keep in mind that this feature is currently in Beta, so we are still continuing to optimize server performance, and you may encounter some other unexpected issues. Continue to report any bugs you encounter to our team and we will get onto the job!
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/46237554/8ce6c1b52824994a185580a8e5409ac42afb822a.png"]

Go Trick or Building with your crew with brand new costumes! The new ‘Costumes’ feature completely transforms your Bean’s look, while still letting you layer your favourite accessories on top. You’ll even notice a couple of familiar faces, or lack thereof…

To get you into the spirit, the Skeleton Costume will be instantly available for all players. But are you looking for something a little wackier? You can unlock the rest of the new costumes by completing all the Certifications for each Crisis Job:
Hotel Hapless: Unlocks the Hapless Costume, a half eaten Bean who thought it would be a good idea to poke a stick at a grizzly bear, complete with voice reactive blood spurts.
Beach Breach: Unlocks the Buff Bean Costume, because who wouldn’t want to flex their muscles as a swole Bean in trunks?!

Drain Strain: Unlocks the Doomed Costume. After the unfortunate mistake of scratching a drug dealer's brand new ride, this Bean landed himself in a trash bag. This costume also includes a ‘Realism’ mode… but we’ll let you discover what that does for yourself!

Crane Climb: Unlocks the Alien Costume, straight from Beanulon Prime! This bug eyed extraterrestrial tries its best to blend in, but its funky head shape and uniquely colored blood instantly blows its cover.
Plus, with extra accessories like Vampire Teeth and a Witches Hat, we cannot wait to see all of the hilarious costumes you’ll create!
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/46237554/d156cbf958783030c2cfd368c97c940f6fd5b582.png"]

With more free content planned and a new Crisis Job around the corner, you won’t want to miss out on the latest news! So, please subscribe to our newsletter for the latest updates and join our community of builders on the official Discord.
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/46237554/a5f35e089e587e015caefcb1feccd39334926f83.png"]
Happy building!
Hey Builders,
A brand-new Crisis Job has washed ashore with Update v3.0 for Dumb Ways to Build, released today on Steam!

As we teased in the blog earlier this week, the Beach Breach update will send your crew to a seaside job where your objective is to fix a leaking Oil Rig amidst crashing waves and the perils of the open ocean. Work together to survive hungry sharks and tackle extra challenges and dangers in the Master Build variant.
The free update also brings new building materials, beach-themed cosmetics and certifications, updates to floating physics, as well as a range of bug fixes. Dive into the full Update Notes below!
Happy building!
Update v3.0
Steam
Build ID: 25919647
Feature Updates
Head out to sea in the new Crisis Job, Beach Breach

Repair the Oil Rig by building your way across the beach, coral reef and open ocean to plug the leaking oil pipes with nailed building objects. Then build your way to the top of the rig and open the valve.
Placed between ‘Hotel Hapless’ and ‘Drain Strain’, Beach Breach is the second job new players take on.
Explore the oil tanker, underwater shark cage, a desert island, and hidden secrets along the way.
Brave the storm in Beach Breach Master Builder
Start out at sea in a polluted, rain-soaked ocean. Navigate between shipwrecks and overturned boats to repair the run-down Oil Rig.
Explosive sea mines float throughout the level with waves and crabs hurling them your way.
Beware of Nailnose, a giant albino shark stalking the waters around the rig.
Don’t go in the water…there's Sharks!
Sharks will actively hunt down swimmers in waters past the shallow reef. They bite, dealing damage and knockback, before circling back to attack again.
Hold the line against massive Waves
Waves sweep across parts of the level, launching loose objects and players. Getting hit by a wave stuns you and knocks you back.
Stay safe and block waves by nailing down building objects, use the Caulk Launcher foam, or drink a Cup of Concrete to eliminate the knockback.
Watch your materials around the Crabs
Crabs will grab your building materials and scuttle away with them. Snatch it back or shoot them with the Nail Gun to retrieve the object.
Mind your toolbox around the Seagulls
Seagulls are found throughout the level and will swoop to snatch dropped or loose items and tools when a Toolbox is opened.
They fly away when you get close, but shooting them with the Nail Gun forces them to drop what they took.
Watch your step on Oil Slicks
Oil slicks will cause you to slip over.
Make a splash with Floating Objects
Building objects in Beach Breach float or sink, depending on what they are made of:
Permanently float: Inflatable Rings, Beach Balls, Surfboards, and more.
Float until stood on: wooden objects, barrels, crates, and more.
Sink: metal and heavy objects, girders, corrugated iron, and more.
Stock up on new Building Materials

Oil Barrels, Surfboards, Wooden Row Boat, Boat Oars, Shark Safety Sign, Crab Warning Sign, Swimming Safety Flags, Starfish, Fish Skeleton, Wooden Barrels, Anchor, and Volleyball (keep an eye out for a familiar face on the desert island…).
The Shark Safety Sign and Crab Warning Sign must be unpinned with a hammer.
Life Savers are bouncy, and pop when shot with the Nail Gun.
Sea Mines are fragile, and explode with high knockback when shot, dropped or hit with a hammer.
Sea Shells will spawn a Crab when picked up.
Treasure Chests open to reveal… a boot.
Bottle & Message. Break open the bottle to reveal a hidden message.
Dress for the beach with new Cosmetics
Unlocked by default for all new and existing players: Pigtails Hair, Knucklehead Hair, Star Glasses, Bucket Head, and Melted Ice Cream.
Mullet Hair: ‘Play On’. Knock another Bean out with a footy.
Life Saver: ‘Rigged Out’. Complete Beach Breach.
Snorkel & Mask: ‘Refined Process’. Complete Beach Breach Time Trial.
Cucumber Eyes: ‘Blowout Prevention’. Complete Beach Breach with zero total deaths.
Flippers: ‘Message in a Bottle’. Read the hidden message.
Seaweed Hair: ‘Davy Jones’ Locker’. Find some sunken treasure.
Shark Fin: ‘Shark Bait’. Throw another Bean to the sharks.
Sandcastle Hat: ‘Sandy Snapshot’. Snap a photo of a Sandcastle.
Lifeguard Cap: ‘Life-Guard’. Complete Beach Breach without anyone harming the wildlife.
Mermaid Ears: ‘Premium Petroleum’. Complete Beach Breach in Master Builder Mode.
Quality of Life Improvements
Updated existing building objects to float or sink in water in Beach Breach.
Added Beach Breach decorations around the job select panel in the Lobby.
Moved the Lobby banana peel gag to the bottom of the stairs.
Bug Fixes
Fixed an issue where pocket trampolines could cancel players’ fall damage.
Fixed an issue where players could clip under floors by slipping while under the effects of Shonky’s Shrinky Drinky.
Fixed an issue where players could clip out of bounds when stunned and picked up by another player using the Telekinesis Tonic.
Fixed an issue where Coconuts could not be broken with Sledgehammers.
Fixed an issue where the Bananail Gun showed nail PFX instead of a banana.
Fixed an issue where knockback from cars in ‘Hotel Hapless’ was not applying to players correctly.
Fixed an issue where Telekinesis Tonic PFX would appear incorrectly in some cases.
Fixed an issue where the Meat Pie and Spicy Hotdog crunching SFX were not playing correctly.
Fixed an issue where bowling pins could not be knocked over by non-host players.
Fixed an issue where bowling pins would not play a “Strike” SFX.
Fixed an issue where the revive action could be cancelled by specific objects.
Fixed an issue where Dippy Chips did not spawn Piranhas when fed to another player.
Fixed an issue where the ‘Take the Plunge’ Certification would not trigger unless the player’s balloon had been popped.
Fixed an issue where players could float while in the Cosmetics or Level Select menu.
Fixed an issue where building objects were not correctly affected by wind zones.
Fixed an issue where the final photo taken with the Instant Camera was only visible to the host.
Fixed environmental occlusion issues in ‘Crane Climb’.
Fixed an issue where photos taken with the Instant Camera were not saving to the user’s “My Pictures” folder.

Life Saver: ‘Rigged Out’. Complete Beach Breach.
Snorkel & Mask: ‘Refined Process’. Complete Beach Breach Time Trial.

releases.displayName: Dumb Ways to Build - Beach Breach Update

items.text: [img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/46237554/6ae2048bc86cb53b489d784f162389f2a4e72c8d.png"]
Hey Builders,
As promised, we are very excited to share with you a first look at the brand new level coming to Dumb Ways to Build this week on October 14 PDT!

Introducing Beach Breach, the next Crisis Job that you and your crewmates have been enlisted to take on. This free update also introduces new building materials, some new friends, deadly oceanic hazards and a boatload of cosmetics to level up the look of your Beans.
Let’s take a look at everything Update 3.0 will have to offer!
Beach Breach gives seaside escape a whole new meaning! Soak up the sun on the shore, meet and greet the local marine life, before taking the plunge into the open ocean.

One misstep will land you in shark infested waters! Scramble back to safety or rely on your trusty crew to toss down building materials to help keep your head above water. Act fast, as the materials won’t stay afloat forever!

Get creative as you build your way through the coastal chaos using brand new materials. Some are sturdy, others are explosive… but we’ll let you discover which is which for yourself. Build your way to the Oil Rig and put your crane skills to the test and plug the oil leaks to ‘save’ the ocean.

Brave the storm in the Master Builder variant of Beach Breach. The Oil Rig is dilapidated and tipping over, and with the rain pouring down, your crew must navigate polluted waters scattered with shipwrecks and sea mines to complete the job at hand! But beware… the giant predator known as Nailnose lurks beneath the surface, waiting for his next meal.
Your dodgy build might get you to the top of the Oil Rig, but will you save the day or just make a mess out of it?

Taking on the Beach Breach Crisis Job is a risky business! Beyond keeping your crew in sync and on task, the local wildlife is waiting to cause extra mayhem and danger. Here’s what you’ll be up against:
Sharks - Beans are not friends, they’re food! If you stumble and fall into the open ocean, you better get back onto dry land fast, otherwise you’ll become a snack for the sharks hunting you down.
Crabs - Watch out for the cheeky crabs who will steal your building objects and scuttle away with them. Chase them down to grab your treasures back!
Seagulls - These pesky birds will swoop you, grab your items and leave you empty handed. Aim true and use your trusty nail gun to get your precious goods back!
A Beach Breach also comes with new environmental hazards to completely derail your crew!

Waves - Surf’s up! Watch out for the giant waves hurtling towards you throughout Beach Breach. Stop the waves from stunning you and sending you to the bottom of the ocean by building structures to protect you and your crew.

Sea Mines - Explosive sea mines pack a punch and are found throughout both Crisis Job variants. In Master Builder, dodge incoming sea mines lobbed at you by crabs and waves, or use their explosive blast force to your advantage.
Oil Slicks - You may want to get oiled up, but you should avoid the oil slicks at all costs! Oil spills splattered on the ground will cause you to slip and send any materials or items in hand flying.
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/46237554/843de56e927625e19ab389ebdbe94dcc4acfac43.png"]

Gear up with 15 new cosmetic items! With several unlocked and ready to equip immediately, while the rest can be earned by completing new Certifications in Beach Breach. From whimsical Mermaid Ears, to Flippers and even a trusty Bucket Hat, you’ll have all the ̶p̶r̶o̶t̶e̶c̶t̶i̶v̶e̶ gear you need to stand out on this oily jobsite.
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/46237554/d156cbf958783030c2cfd368c97c940f6fd5b582.png"]
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/46237554/da8c3754a97fd1d22b55e3bb290f706e3a7eddf3.png"]
Happy building!
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/46237554/039683feac6d2e9bbf02da23a5b5c93f3f27338f.png"]
Hey Builders,

Today, we have released a hotfix for Dumb Ways to Build on Steam, implementing a range of bug fixes across several levels and other aspects of the game. Check out the full notes for Hotfix v2.1 below.
Thank you for continuing to report all issues you have been encountering through our Helpshift page. Our team is on the case.
Happy building!
Hotfix v2.1
Steam
Build ID: 25644049
Quality of Life Improvements
Players can now copy Player ID in the settings menu, making it easier to send this information to Helpshift when requesting support.
Bug Fixes
Fixed an issue with the Mystery Meat texture where the bottom was green.
Fixed an issue in ‘Hotel Hapless’ where the black car in the spawn zone had no collision on it.
Fixed an issue where the notification/pop-up for ‘Certification: Who’s That Cutie’ would fail to appear unless the player opened and closed the Pause Menu.
Fixed an issue in ‘Drain Strain’ where players could get stuck inside the giant fan after drinking Shonky’s Shrinky Drinky and jumping inside the fan.
Fixed an issue in ‘Crane Climb’ where players who joined the lobby after the level started would not see the crane cables moving.
Fixed a crash in ‘Crane Climb’ that could occur if players replayed the level multiple times in a row without returning back to the lobby.
Hey Builders,
We have just released the Power Tools & Packed Lunches update for Dumb Ways to Build on Steam! Check out the update trailer below:

As revealed in our blog earlier this week, Update v2.0 adds a bunch of content, including new tools and delicious items to spice up gameplay. Plus, enjoy a range of bug fixes and quality of life improvements, including the Expanded Ping System and dynamic player expressions. Check out the full Update Notes below!

On top of this update, the development team has been hard at work creating even more content (including a brand-new level), and we can’t wait to share more news on that soon. Until then, jump into the free update now.
Happy building!
Update v2.0
Steam
Build ID: 25570777
Feature Updates
Blow away items (and your friends) with the Blow-Vac
Creates a wind-zone that pushes back items and players. The alt mode can suck in and store up to three objects, building materials, and even players to then launch them out later.
Grab your Caulk Launcher and get to work
Creates expanding foam blobs that can be used as temporary platforms once hardened or to pin down materials and items.
Reach new heights with the Pocket Spring Loaded Platform
Deploys a spring loaded platform that can launch players and objects across obstacles.
Create sweet music with the Drumsticks
Make different sounds and melodies based upon what you hit, including your teammates.
Even the smallest of Beans can help with Shonky's Shrinky Drinky
Shrinks the player down to a small size for a set amount of time, allowing them to be thrown further by others.
Harden up and have a Cup of Concrete
Coats the user in hardened concrete which gives immunity to all damage and knockback effects, and allows building objects to be unpinned by touching them.
Unleash your hidden powers with the Telekinesis Tonic
Allows the user to pick up and rotate objects and other players from a greater distance.
Get swole with the Dumbbell Protein Shake
Increases the user’s size and throw strength.
The Double Shot Espresso will give you an instant pick-me-up
Increases movement speed and causes the user’s arms to shake randomly.
Crazy for Coconuts
The coconuts, when broken, can be eaten to restore health.
Quality of Life Improvements
Added additional graffiti to ‘Hotel Hapless’ in normal difficulty, highlighting game mechanics such as rotating held objects, and increasing or decreasing the distance of held objects.
Added a Lightning Rod spawner to ‘Crane Climb’, which can spawn infinite Lightning Rods.
Added a selfie functionality to the Instant Camera.
Added visual improvements for flares, where the smoke changes colour based on the player who activates them.
Added the functionality for players to feed food items to other players.

Added improvements to character expressions, where player mouth movements now dynamically sync and mimic phonetic mouth positions when speaking. Characters now also blink every few seconds, and pull unique facial expressions when impacted by status effects.
Added an Expanded Ping System, giving players six ping options to better communicate.
Added additional first person visual and audio feedback to highlight when players are low health.
Added additional visual feedback to highlight when players restore their health.
Added additional UI in the Lobby to highlight when players unlock new content such as Master Builder mode and Levels.
Added the ability for players to emote while inside the customization menu.
Changed brown and gold Item Crate visuals with Toolboxes that can also be used as building materials.
Improved existing consumables visual detail, audio feedback, and HUD display.
Improved the effect of existing consumables.
Improved visuals of the Nail Gun reticule, where it now changes shape to indicate whether the nail will pin an object or not.
Improved building material colliders to address objects flying when a material is moved from the bottom of a pile.
Players no longer drop their held items when they die. If revived by another player, items are kept. If revived at a Port-a-loo, players will drop their items where they died.
Improved the collider on the plug in ‘Drain Strain’.
Removed the following consumables: Baked Beans, Cheese, Clod Cola, Lax Lemonade, Putz Protein, and Battery Acid.
Developer note: Items have been removed due to redundancy or where new consumables replace their functionality.
Bug Fixes
Fixed an issue where solo players could get softlocked in ‘Crane Climb’ Master Builder in the balloon popping section.
Fixed issues where objects being held could clip into the world.
Fixed an issue where players could get stuck floating mid-air after exiting a lobby while holding a buildable object and then rejoining the lobby.
Fixed an issue where UI would render through the treadmill treads.
Fixed multiple collision and visual misalignment issues across all levels.
Fixed a visual issue with the ‘Classic Dance' emote when transitioning into a different emote.
Fixed issue where only the host player would take fall damage when being hit off a ledge by a sledgehammer.
Fixed an issue where players being stunned or revived would teleport.
Fixed an issue where players who died in the lobby and then spectacted using the walkie talkie could see their characters’ arms when looking in the mirror.
Fixed an issue where the incorrect audio SFX played when using the Plunger.
Fixed an issue where the white highlight to showcase an object can be nailed would fail to appear.
Fixed an issue where repeatedly using the ‘Point and Laugh’ Emote would change the camera angle and point of view.
Fixed an issue in ‘Crane Climb’ Master Builder where some conveyor belts were not pushing players off platforms.
Fixed an issue where players could not view Certifications on the end of round screen when using a controller.
Fixed an issue where the UI prompt to ‘Freeze’ wasn’t appearing while holding certain building objects in solo mode.
Fixed an issue where the ropes on cranes in ‘Crane Climb’ would not lengthen or shorten based on the height of the platform.
Fixed an issue where the level complete audio continues to play in the lobby if the player spams the A or X button on a controller when completing a level.
Fixed an issue where a player’s arms could get stuck in the free rotate position if another player used a Plunger on an object they were holding.
Fixed an issue where players could nail a Piranha in place if they shot at a building object between them and the piranha.
Fixed an issue where footballs did not pop when shot at with the Nail Gun.
Fixed an issue where players in solo mode could not grab objects that were frozen in place.
Fixed an issue where players could not kill Piranhas or Sewer Slimes when the host disconnects from the lobby.

releases.displayName: Dumb Ways to Build - Power Tools & Packed Lunches Update

items.text: [img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/46237554/14a46398cacc7e91e1a7da0b215de16ae36370bc.png"]
Hey Builders,
We are so excited to announce brand-new content for Dumb Ways to Build, which releases… this week!

Introducing Power Tools & Packed Lunches, our latest free update where the game's food and toolbox system has been revamped to make it better than ever! We have tossed in a bunch of new tools and lunchbox loot that only the dumbest construction crew members would dare touch.
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/46237554/c063cb2f6cdfc8d8b808fad4287dc6e1237ee49b.png"]

Get ready for the latest shipment of tools and building materials from Stumble and Sons! (Disclaimer: Stumble and Sons assumes no liability for loss of life, building mishap, or the otherwise highly perilous nature of these items)

Blow-Vac - Harness the destructive power of… vacuums! The Blow-Vac is a new tool that can blow back items and even other players. Is something too far away for your friends to grab? Blow-Vac! Are your friends in desperate need of a cool breeze? Blow-Vac! Better yet, the Blow-Vac can also suck in objects and store them to be launched later. Hoover has a whole new meaning with this latest innovation in Dumbville!

Caulk Launcher - Whip out your Caulk Launcher to create foam blobs that expand and harden, designed to temporarily support the weight of any Bean, or pin down materials and items. A well-placed caulk can even safely break your fall. With the Caulk Launcher, no place will be out of reach!

Pocket Spring Loaded Platform - It fits in your pocket, and it’s a spring-loaded platform. Even the dimmest workers in Dumbville can figure out the rest. While we can’t assure your complete safety with this new building material, we can promise you one thing… unsafety!
Drumsticks - Calling all musicians! Grab the drumsticks and swing them at objects to create dynamic melodies based on what you hit, or even tap them on your teammates to test out how hollow they are.

Got the munchies? No problem! Your lunchboxes won’t know what hit ‘em with the latest and greatest consumables, designed to keep you refreshed while out in the field and mix-up your adventures in Dumbville.

Shonky's Shrinky Drinky - A delicious new drinky, Shonky's Shrinky Drinky can shrink you down to a small size for a set amount of time, allowing you to reach even the tiniest of places. While in this small state, your friends will also be able to throw you further!

Cup of Concrete - Take a spoonful of concrete and harden up! When consumed, the Cup of Concrete will coat you in a hardened concrete that provides immunity to all damage and knockback effects. Players covered in concrete can even unpin building objects just by touching them.

Telekinesis Tonic - Bio Shock your heart out! The brand-new Telekinesis Tonic makes quick work of heavy chores with just a thought, allowing you to pick up and rotate both objects and other players from a greater distance.

Dumbbell Protein Shake - Gym bros, don’t neglect your gains by missing out on the Dumbbell Protein Shake, capable of increasing your size and throwing distance. Your friends will marvel at your newfound strength thanks to this shake!

Double Shot Espresso - Feeling sleepy before your morning shift? Better grab a Double Shot Espresso, which will give you a massive boost to your speed. But be careful, it may produce an unwanted side effect of the jitters…
Coconut - And finally, coconuts! When smashed open, the Coconut can be eaten to quickly restore health, or lobbed at your teammates when they are not paying attention.
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/46237554/5e0e6004c012c1d7fdcf7b9ef2956bc71a65d113.png"]

As if new tools and consumables weren’t enough, our latest update will also implement a range of quality of life improvements and bug fixes. We will provide the full list with our Update Notes this week, but here are the highlights!
Expanded Ping System - Arms your chaotic crew with 6 new ping options to level up the coordination of your shoddy structures and help warn your buddies just before things go south.
Selfie Camera - Say beans! Grab the Instant Camera and snap a selfie with your teammates to capture wholesome memories throughout the mayhem.
Feed Your Friends - Have you ever picked up a 2-week-old unrefrigerated pie and wondered whether eating it will make you sick? Well, now you can feed it to your friend(s) to test the effects!

Improved Character Expressiveness - Your bean-sona has had a lip-syncing upgrade, with mouths now moving and tracking every bit of chatter! Bring out your inner drama bean when hit with a status effect, whether that’s looking ill after being poisoned or mogging after chugging a Dumbbell Protein Shake.
Happy building!
Hey Builders!

Today, we have released a Hotfix for Dumb Ways to Build on Steam, which looks to address server connection issues, primarily for some players in Japan and Russia who have been unable to connect to multiplayer games. We have also implemented a fix for players who were experiencing an issue where items would disappear from their inventory.
Please continue to report any connectivity or other bugs through our Helpshift page. We will continue to monitor any issues as they arise!
Patch v1.3.83
Steam
Build ID: 25494810
Bug fixes
Fixed an issue for players who are unable to connect to multiplayer games in Russia and Japan.

Fixed an issue where picking up a new item with a full inventory, while not currently holding an item, caused an existing inventory item to drop and teleport away, causing it to disappear from the player's perspective.

Hey Builders!

We have just released a brand new patch for Dumb Ways to Build on Steam, implementing a range of bug fixes, including instances of players not taking fall damage, issues inviting friends in a cross-platform lobby, and more. The full set of patch notes can be found below.
Thank you for all of your feedback! Our development team has been reading your reviews and comments, and we are excitedly planning new content for the game, so watch this space.
Patch v1.3.0
Steam
Build ID: 25334180
Performance Updates
Holstered tools and idle animation improvements to reduce network issues.
Ragdoll animation improvements after throwing or dropping a player.
Animation improvements to the fans in ‘Drain Strain’ to reduce network issues.
Improvements to Room Code generation to eliminate region-specific character issues.
On launch, the game will now detect PC hardware and specifications to automatically adjust graphics settings. Changing settings manually will override this.
Bug Fixes
Fixed an issue where duplicate Room Codes could be generated.
Fixed an issue that allowed special characters such as !@# to be generated in room codes.
Fixed an issue where a player will not take fall damage if they are dropped off (not thrown) off an edge.
Fixed an issue preventing players from accessing the ‘Invite Friends’ menu while inside a cross-platform lobby.
Fixed an issue where players could hold Sewer Slimes and Piranhas to use as a platform to boost and lift other players.
Removed Inflatable Duck exploit allowing players to “fly”.
Fixed an issue where the first job in Hotel Hapless will fail to complete if the host of the session disconnects from the lobby.
Fixed an issue where the Crane keeps moving if an object on the button of the pad is destroyed.
Fixed an issue where players could receive Lobby Invites while in screens where invites could not be accepted.
Fixed the framerate issue caused by having an Oculus virtual microphone selected as the microphone.
Fixed an issue where duplex speaker/mics would not show up as an option when choosing the microphone.
Fixed an issue where the Steam EULA pop up would sometimes appear mid-game.

Hey Builders!
We just released a patch for Dumb Ways to Build on Steam to address reported issues.

We are aware that users in China may be having issues accessing Dumb Ways to Build. This is due to a whitelisting issue with some accelerator providers. This may also affect Voice Chat in-game for some users.

This update should address connection and voice chat issues affecting some players in China. This update may disable voice chat for some players. We continue to investigate this issue and will provide an update for affected players soon.
A fix has also been implemented to ensure duplicate room code cannot be generated.
